cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave me in this new flat, count five breaths with me. Slowly, the way I showed you before your exams.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. You still race the last one. Count again while I look at the empty kitchen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned not to hurry someone. Stay until it boils. Then I'll try pouring one cup without getting yours out.

reason: Let the familiar mentor-pupil habits shape the request, correction or concession. Preserve B actual contribution while allowing A to need help without explaining the combination to an evaluator.
